senses.gloss: (v. next w.) to be white, pure, charitable, graceful.—Part. pass. חָסוּד, fem. חֲסוּדָה, endowed with חֶסֶד, graceful.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 17a:1">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> (in a bridal song) <he>כלה נאה וח׳</he> handsome and graceful bride.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:12">Num. R. s. 12</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:10">Cant. R. to III, 10</cite> (not <cite ref="H01370"><he>חסידה</he></cite>).
